items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We used to hang out together.

ctx.x: That’s what I was going to ask you. He wanted to be a balladeer.
Then I didn’t get around to doing that. I didn’t get around to doing that, and he sort of acted mad towards me, because I wouldn’t do it, but that’s Little Willie John, selfish.

Let me ask you something about that, because what I’ve always heard about Little Willie John – a lot of people think was one of the best rhythm-and-blues vocalists ever, along with Clyde McPhatter . . .
